title: time.now
description: Return the current wall-clock time in the requested IANA timezone.

zone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Defaults to the system local zone if omitted.

format.description: Output format. 'iso' (default) returns ISO 8601 with the zone's UTC offset; 'human' returns a readable form like '2:32 PM EDT'.
